|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Han Seeker (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Use 1 Force to deploy on opponent's side at any unoccupied site. Moves during your control phase like a character. When present with a smuggler of ability < 3 or Han with permanent weapon, choose one to be lost (along with Seeker).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Use 1 Force to deploy to an unoccupied site. Deploys and moves like an Undercover spy. If present with [[Permanent Weapon]] Han or a smuggler of ability < 3, this weapon and that character are lost (“all cards” situation).” '''What changed:''' “on opponent's side at any” → “to an”; “Moves during your control phase” → “Deploys and moves”; “a character. When” → “an Undercover spy. If”; added “Permanent Weapon Han or”; “3 or Han with permanent weapon, choose one to be” → “3, this weapon and that character are”; “(along with Seeker).” → “(“all cards” situation).”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 34. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Han Seeker]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
